Tasks.?: Upload files, preserving subfolders. Keep the source files.
Upload a selected file under a different SharePoint name, archive it under its original name after success, then remove the source.

MaxConcurrent.JobsTotal: Positive integer: maximum simultaneous source jobs across all computers. Each selected folder or explicit file is one job.
MaxConcurrent.JobsPerComputer: Positive integer: maximum simultaneous source jobs per computer, or per file server for UNC sources. Files within a folder are uploaded sequentially.

Tasks.ComputerName: Use localhost for local paths, a remote computer name for paths on that computer, or null for UNC paths processed by the script host.

Upload.?: Required object. Select at least one source across Folders and Files. Either list may be omitted or empty; null and scalar lists are invalid. Both lists accept absolute local or UNC paths, or objects with Path and optional string Name for reporting. Paths are literal; wildcards are not supported. ENV: values resolve on the script host. Duplicate and overlapping sources on the same computer are rejected, including explicit files inside selected folders.
Upload.Folders: Upload the contents of these folders. Recurse controls subfolder traversal and relative paths. Each selected folder is one job.
Upload.Files: Upload only these specific files, without enumerating their parent folders. Each file is one job. String entries keep their original filename. Object entries accept Path, optional Name (report label), and optional SharePointFileName (destination filename, including its desired extension). SharePointFileName affects only the upload inside SharePoint.FolderPath; local and CopyToFolder filenames stay unchanged. Omit it to keep the original name. If provided, it must be a nonempty literal filename of at most 255 characters, without paths, invalid SharePoint characters, or leading/trailing periods or whitespace. SharePoint.Overwrite applies to the resulting destination name. Folder entries do not support this option.

Tasks.Recurse: Boolean required when Upload.Folders is nonempty; optional for file-only tasks. Applies only to Upload.Folders. true preserves relative subfolders in SharePoint and in CopyToFolder; false uploads only files directly in each selected folder. Hidden/system files are included unless excluded; directory links are not followed.

Exclude.?: Optional exclusions for this task. Omit unused properties or use empty arrays. An empty object means no exclusions. Excluded files are not uploaded, copied, or removed. Excluded folder trees are not entered. Excluded items are not errors or upload results; genuine access errors are still reported.
Exclude.Attributes: Optional array containing Hidden, System, both, or neither. Items matching ANY listed attribute are excluded. Folder selections check files and folders, including source roots; explicit file selections check the selected file's own attributes. Defaults to [] when omitted.
Exclude.Folders: Optional array of absolute folder paths to skip, including all their contents. Each path must be a subfolder of a source in this task's Upload.Folders. Paths are literal, case-insensitive and normalized; wildcards are not supported. Supports ENV: values resolved on the script host.
Exclude.Files: Optional array of absolute file paths to skip. Each path must be below a source in this task's Upload.Folders or match one of its Upload.Files selections. Paths are literal, case-insensitive and normalized; wildcards are not supported. Supports ENV: values resolved on the script host.

SharePoint.SiteUrl: Required HTTPS site URL, not a library or sharing URL.
SharePoint.DocumentLibraryName: Required library display name. Documents and Shared Documents are accepted aliases.
SharePoint.FolderPath: Optional folder inside the library. Missing folders are created. Empty means library root. Each source folder's contents go here, without its root folder name. Explicitly selected files go here using SharePointFileName when configured, otherwise their original filename, without their local parent folder path.
SharePoint.Overwrite: Optional Boolean, default false. true replaces existing SharePoint files. false or omission reports an error if a destination file already exists, and leaves the source untouched. Applies to SharePoint only; existing archive files are never overwritten.
SharePoint.ClientId: Required app registration client ID, or ENV:VARIABLE_NAME.
SharePoint.CertificateThumbprint: Required certificate thumbprint, or ENV:VARIABLE_NAME. Certificate/private key and credential environment variables must exist for the executing account on the worker computer. All tasks must use identical authentication settings.
SharePoint.MaxRetries: Optional positive integer, default 3. Maximum attempts per Graph call, not per complete source job.
SharePoint.ChunkSizeMB: Optional integer 1-60, default 5. Large-file chunks are rounded down to a 320 KiB boundary.

AfterUpload.RemoveFile: Optional Boolean, default false. Remove a source file only after confirmed upload and, when configured, successful copying.
AfterUpload.CopyToFolder: Optional absolute local or UNC folder; null/empty disables copying. ENV: values resolve on the script host. Must be outside every selected source folder and must not contain any explicitly selected source file on that computer. Folder selections preserve relative paths; explicit files are copied by filename. Missing archive folders are created. Existing archive files are never overwritten; a collision is reported and the source is kept. With RemoveFile false this copies and retains the source; with true it archives then removes it.

?.PSSessionConfiguration: Optional remote endpoint name, default PowerShell.7. No complete-job retries: retrying destructive post-upload actions may repeat uploads.

Settings.ScriptName: Required name used in reporting and log filenames.

SendMail.When: Never, Always, OnError, or OnErrorOrAction. Action means at least one confirmed upload, even if its post-upload action failed.
SendMail.From: Required unless Never. Supports ENV: values, as do FromDisplayName, SMTP fields and assembly paths.
SendMail.To: Recipient array. At least one To or Bcc recipient is required unless Never.
SendMail.Subject: Optional text appended to the generated uploaded/error count subject.
SendMail.Body: Optional trusted HTML displayed before the results table.
SendMail.Smtp: ServerName and Port required unless Never. Ports: 25, 465, 587, 2525. ConnectionType: None (default), Auto, SslOnConnect, StartTls, StartTlsWhenAvailable. Set both UserName and Password or neither.
SendMail.AssemblyPath: MailKit and MimeKit DLL paths required unless Never. Install MailKit/MimeKit and their dependencies on the script host.

Where.Folder: Optional log folder, supporting ENV:. Relative paths are relative to this script folder. Null/empty disables files. Excel Overview records file/task results with FullName, CreationTime, LastWriteTime, Length (bytes), completed Action and upload/copy/removal status. No Excel file is created when there is nothing to upload and no file/task errors, including when all source files are excluded. The Errors worksheet is created only when file/task errors occur and contains their diagnostic details. A separate System errors log.json contains only configuration/reporting errors and is created only when such errors occur. HTML is saved when sending mail.

SaveLogFiles.DeleteLogsAfterDays: Optional nonnegative whole number. 0/omitted retains logs forever. Positive values remove only this script/configuration's generated logs older than that many elapsed days, by LastWriteTime. Use a dedicated log folder outside all upload sources.

Settings.SaveInEventLog: Save is a required Boolean. LogName is required when enabled and supports ENV:. Provision the event source beforehand when the scheduled account cannot create it.
